sources.title: Kokoro 82M - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Kokoro is a compact 82M parameter text to speech model with open weights. Despite its small size it targets audio quality on par with much larger systems while remaining significantly faster and cheaper to run. Packaged via the kokoro inference library, it supports multiple languages and easy deployment from personal projects to production services.

sources.title: aiplexdeveloper/Kokoro-82M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Kokoro is an open-weight TTS model with 82 million parameters. Despite its lightweight architecture, it delivers comparable quality to larger models while being significantly faster and more cost-efficient. With Apache-licensed weights, Kokoro can be deployed anywhere from production environments to personal projects.
